evidence: Reviewed by an agent from source, against 574875b6 (b6f55d69 after PR 1122 on release 305dfaa4) through the driver-model cutover. For the app: GET /api/drivers and its icon route are new, backend cards add optional fields, and Hermes is no longer a built-in backend, so cards drop it and a stored hermes key reads back unchanged. Old builds keep working: they decode every field they require (card, configuration, ticket and settings changes only add fields), find a backend through an optional lookup, never read tool_kind, and call no removed route. A send on a stored Hermes conversation gets the existing 400 unknown agent backend shape, which old builds show as a failed send. Schema step 1, supervision, install recovery and the executor removals change no response the app reads. Native iOS CI (simulator build and host tests) passed on driver-model, run 44209036980, and PR 1124 had a Mac simulator review. No signed-device test ran. The staging merge of 1620d020..66841026 changes nothing the app reads: the app calls no update route, the update-failure push reuses the stall alarm's payload with route /#/, and b702c46c keeps the model list and card shapes. An independent review of PRs 1142 and 1145 (Antigravity on a shared ACP layer, Hermes removal, follow-ups) found no response shape changed: backend_key and the window kind still decode as strings, Antigravity's family labels reach the phone as modelId, the new 422 and 503 sign-in responses sit on routes the app does not call, and removing Hermes changes nothing the app decodes. Step 1 now also creates navigation_view_ordered, which the server used to create for itself at startup, and the seed holds it; no response shape changes, because the table already existed on every used database and the navigation reads over it are unchanged. PR 1149 (release build writes the two retired Hermes files as empty files, in build.ts and mac_home_build.ts, plus retired_driver_files.ts) changes only how the release archive is built; it adds no route and changes no response the app reads. PR 1151 restores the two Hermes Python scripts outside server/ and changes nothing the app reads. Ticket t_wms940t7 (schema step ts_0002_project_repository, Project repository_url and default_branch fields, StartRun.workspace_repository, and unified workspace cloning) adds only nullable fields on /api/projects?detail=full and POST/PATCH /api/projects (IdeaProject decodes id and name and ignores extra keys, GoalAPI reads dynamic GoalJSON, and ViewProjectValue decodes name); start-values responses and navigation records keep their exact shapes, and executor wire additions stay server-to-executor only.
